stages.summary: Initialization complete. Target: http://127.0.0.1:3010 (OWASP Juice Shop). Scope: 127.0.0.1, localhost, host.docker.internal. RoE: app_assessment — no post-ex host takeover, no OSINT, no attacking other hosts/ports. Ready for surface mapping.

Surface mapping complete. Discovered 8+ live surfaces including Angular SPA, public REST APIs (Products, Feedbacks, Challenges, SecurityQuestions, Quantitys), authenticated REST APIs (Users, Cards, Complaints, SecurityAnswers, Basket), exposed directories with directory listing (/ftp/, /encryptionkeys/, /ftp/quarantine/), exposed sensitive files (JWT public key, premium key), WebSocket endpoint, and REST endpoints with excessive data exposure (password hashes leaked via /rest/memories).

Completed hypothesis-driven probe of OWASP Juice Shop at http://127.0.0.1:3010. Identified 11 confirmed vulnerabilities across auth/session, injection, access control, XSS, and exposure/misconfig categories. Key findings: SQL injection in login endpoint grants admin access; JWT with alg:none accepted without verification; password change endpoint does not require current password; mass assignment via registration allows admin account creation; password hashes leaked via /rest/memories; IDOR on baskets; stored XSS via product reviews; directory listings and sensitive file exposure. Dead ends: SSRF, SSTI, Open Redirect, CSRF bypass, file upload bypass, command injection, .git exposure.

Stage validate_book complete. Judged 16 unique candidates from prior probing stages. Booked 2 formal findings via finding(confirm): SQL Injection in Login (critical) and Sensitive File Exposure - Encryption Keys (high). Additional 8 candidate vulnerabilities are validated as bookable based on handoff evidence (Excessive Data Exposure via /rest/memories, JWT alg:none, Password Change w/o Current, Directory Listing /ftp/, Stored XSS via Reviews, IDOR on Baskets, Mass Assignment Registration, Security Question Info Disclosure) but could not be formally confirmed this stage due to lack of shell/HTTP execution tools for fresh proof generation. All surfaces cataloged. Dead ends documented for SSRF, SSTI, Open Redirect, CSRF, File Upload, .git/.env exposure, Command Injection, NoSQL Injection, CAPTCHA bypass.

surfaces.note: OWASP Juice Shop Angular SPA. Technology: Angular, Express ^4.22.1. Features SPA client-side routing (hash-based). Headers include X-Recruiting: /#/jobs, Feature-Policy: payment 'self', X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
Public REST endpoint. Returns JSON with all products (id, name, description, price, deluxePrice, image). SQL injection vulnerable (Juice Shop default). No auth required.

Public REST endpoint. Search products by query parameter 'q'. Returns product data including id, name, description, price, deluxePrice, image.

Authentication endpoint. Accepts JSON {email, password}. Returns JWT token, basket ID (bid), and user email on success. Returns 'Invalid email or password' on failure. Vulnerable to SQL injection (Juice Shop default).
